name: The Knight
one_line: The silent protagonist, a discarded Vessel infused with Void seeking to break the seal on the Temple of the Black Egg.

name: Hornet
one_line: Daughter of the Pale King and Herrah the Beast, fierce protector of Hallownest and protagonist of Silksong.

name: The Hollow Knight
one_line: The chosen Vessel raised by the Pale King to contain the Radiance, ultimately tarnished by an idea instilled.

name: The Pale King
one_line: The reincarnated higher being Wyrm who founded Hallownest, expanded bug intellect, and initiated the Vessel project.

name: The White Lady
one_line: The Pale King's consort, a higher being root who willingly bound herself to curb her insatiable fertility.

name: The Radiance
one_line: The primordial light goddess of dreams and creator of the Moth Tribe, source of the orange Infection.

name: Herrah the Beast
one_line: Common bug queen of Deepnest who agreed to become a Dreamer on condition of bearing the Pale King a royal child (Hornet).

name: Lurien the Watcher
one_line: Aristocratic Dreamer who watched over the City of Tears through his telescope, devoted unconditionally to the King.

name: Monomon the Teacher
one_line: Intellectual Dreamer who archived knowledge and foresaw the necessity of the seal's eventual breach by a Vessel.

name: Quirrel
one_line: Former assistant to Monomon who bore her mask across the outer wastes and returned to aid the Knight.

name: Cloth
one_line: Nomadic cicada warrior seeking courage in battle, who helps the Knight against the Traitor Lord.

name: Tiso
one_line: Boastful warrior seeking glorious lethal combat in the Colosseum of Fools.

name: Zote the Mighty
aliases: A Knight of Great Renown, Grey Prince Zote
one_line: Comically delusioned warrior who recites the Fifty-Seven Precepts of Zote while constantly needing rescue.

name: Elderbug
one_line: Sole remaining resident of Dirtmouth at the start of the journey, welcoming travelers to the ruins.

name: Cornifer
one_line: Cheerful mosquito cartographer who explores caverns ahead of the player, humming as he charts maps.

name: Iselda
one_line: Cornifer's wife and former warrior who sells maps and navigational pins in Dirtmouth.

name: Sly
one_line: Dwarf merchant saved from infection who secretly mastered all Great Nail Arts.

name: Bretta
one_line: Rescued bug who romanticizes her saviors, projecting fantasies onto the Knight and later Zote.

name: Myla
one_line: Joyful mining bug whose cheerful songs gradually succumb to the psychic resonance of the Infection.

name: The Seer
one_line: Ancient moth guide who bestows the Dream Nail and gathers Essence to atone for her tribe's betrayal of the Radiance.

name: Salubra
one_line: Ecstatic charm vendor who sells charms and notches to travelers imbued with blessing.

name: Leg Eater
one_line: Blind scavenger selling fragile charms, driven by ravenous greed and infatuation with Divine.

name: Divine
one_line: Giant termite member of the Grimm Troupe who transmutes fragile charms into unbreakable variants by devouring them.

name: Brumm
one_line: Accordion player of the Grimm Troupe who seeks to banish the nightmare ritual to free his kin.

name: Confessor Jiji
one_line: Mysterious cavern hermit who summons the Knight's lost Shade in exchange for Rancid Eggs.

name: Steel Soul Jinn
one_line: Construct who replaces Jiji in Steel Soul mode, trading Rancid Eggs for pure Geo.

name: Ogrim
one_line: Loyal Five Great Knight who guards the Waterways with boisterous dung projectiles, dreaming of the King's court.

name: Isma
one_line: One of the Five Great Knights whose organic botanical teardrop grants complete immunity to acid.

name: Ze'mer
one_line: One of the Five Great Knights, an outsider from a distant land who mourns her lost love, the Traitor's Child.

name: Dryya
one_line: Five Great Knight who died defending the entrance to the White Lady's sanctuary from the Traitor mantises.

name: Hegemol
one_line: Five Great Knight revered for his massive ornate armor, which was stolen by a Maggot to become the False Knight.

name: Mantis Lords
one_line: Trio of proud mantis leaders who resisted the Radiance's Infection through strict honor and physical discipline.

name: Traitor Lord
one_line: Fourth mantis lord who embraced the Infection willingly to gain colossal strength after being exiled.

name: Nailmaster Oro
one_line: Reclusive nailmaster who teaches the Dash Slash in exchange for Geo, harboring bitterness toward Mato.

name: Nailmaster Mato
one_line: Devoted nailmaster who treats the Knight as an adopted disciple, teaching the Cyclone Slash.

name: Nailmaster Sheo
one_line: Nailmaster who retired from martial violence to pursue painting and sculpting, teaching the Great Slash.

name: False Knight
one_line: Maggot who donned Hegemol's stolen armor to protect his kin from predatory bugs.

name: Gruz Mother
one_line: Sleeping winged fly matriarch whose corpse bursts into swarming larvae upon defeat.

name: Brooding Mawlek
one_line: Lonely subterranean beast that spews infection blobs while crying out for companionship.

name: Soul Master
one_line: Head scholar of the Soul Sanctum who hoarded life energy from citizens, succumbing to megalomania.

name: Broken Vessel
one_line: Discarded Vessel corpse animated and puppeteered by Lightseeds and orange Infection cords.

name: Watcher Knights
one_line: Six heavy armored sentinels reanimated by infected flies to guard Lurien's slumber.

name: Uumuu
one_line: Massive protective jellyfish guarding Monomon, vulnerable only when pierced by Quirrel's blade.

name: Nosk
one_line: Predatory arachnid shapeshifter that mimics familiar visages to lure prey into its larder.

name: Hive Knight
one_line: Loyal knight who continues defending the deceased Queen Vespa, unaware of her demise.

name: The Collector
one_line: Four-armed Void entity obsessed with preserving grubs inside glass jars to keep them safe.

name: Troupe Master Grimm
one_line: Master of the ritualistic Grimm Troupe who feeds the Nightmare Heart on burnt ruined kingdoms.

name: Godseeker
one_line: Priestess from the Land of Storms who uses the Godtuner to attune to the gods of Hallownest.

name: Shade Lord
one_line: The unified cosmic intelligence of the Void that consumes the Absolute Radiance and Godhome.

name: Dirtmouth
one_line: Quiet decaying town situated directly above the ruins of Hallownest.

name: Forgotten Crossroads
one_line: Central subterranean junction of ancient highways connecting upper and lower kingdom zones.

name: Greenpath
one_line: Overgrown subterranean garden of moss, acid pools, and lush vegetation cultivated by Unn.

name: Fog Canyon
one_line: Humid canyon filled with bioluminescent jellyfish, explosive bubbles, and the Teacher's Archives.

name: Fungal Wastes
one_line: Spore-choked region inhabited by sentient mushroom tribes and the fortified Mantis Village.

name: City of Tears
one_line: Grand capital built of black stone beneath the Blue Lake, subject to eternal rainfall.

name: Soul Sanctum
one_line: High academy where scholarly bugs experimented on captive mortals to harvest Soul.

name: Royal Waterways
one_line: Dank sewer system populated by flukes, dung piles, and drainage channels beneath the capital.

name: Deepnest
one_line: Uncharted subterranean labyrinth of arachnids, centipedes, dirt tunnels, and predatory darkness.

name: Ancient Basin
one_line: Barren, silent stone expanse beneath the capital, housing the tramway and palace remains.

name: The Abyss
one_line: Darkest ocean of primordial Void where the Pale King cast down thousands of his sacrificial children.

name: Crystal Peak
one_line: Industrial crystal quarry where bugs once mined singing pink crystals before succumbing to madness.

name: Resting Grounds
one_line: Quiet ancestral cemetery where the Moth Tribe buried Hallownest's dead and tended dream essence.

name: Kingdom's Edge
one_line: Desolate cliffside covered in falling white ash shed by the decomposing giant Wyrm corpse.

name: The Hive
one_line: Isolated amber civilization governed by golden honey bees who rejected the Pale King's beacon.

name: Queen's Gardens
one_line: Lush botanical sanctuary overgrown with thorns where the White Lady went into self-imposed exile.

name: White Palace
one_line: The King's pristine dream palace replete with buzzsaws, spikes, and the Path of Pain.

name: Godhome
one_line: Golden dream domain created by the Godseeker mind where pantheons of Hallownest deities are battled.

name: Hornet (Protagonist)
one_line: Captured princess of Hallownest who breaks free from her cage and ascends the vertical kingdom of Pharloom.

name: Shakra
one_line: Fierce ring-wielding cartographer tracking her lost master across Pharloom, mapping areas.

name: Forge-Daughter
one_line: Towering blacksmith in the Deep Docks who upgrades Hornet's needle and crafts heavy strike gear.

name: Eva
one_line: Reclusive weaver seer who recognizes Hornet's heritage and reveals secrets of ancient silk spinning.

name: Sherma
one_line: Optimistic, clumsy pilgrim traveling upward toward the Citadel on a spiritual journey of devotion.

name: Garmond and Zaza
one_line: Boisterous knight mounted atop an ancient, talkative bug hound who assists Hornet.

name: Trobbio
one_line: Flamboyant, vain butterfly dramatist and stage master who duels Hornet in a flash of fireworks.

name: Lace
one_line: Sardonic, white-cloaked rapier fencer who tests Hornet's resolve across recurring acrobatic duels.

name: Lost Lace
one_line: Tragic end-game manifestation of Lace bound by corrupted golden thread.

name: Last Judge
one_line: Towering, golden-masked bell executor guarding the threshold between lower Pharloom and the High Citadel.

name: Steel Assassin Sharpe
one_line: Lethal robotic assassin from a distant land dispatched to hunt Hornet and eliminate her royal lineage.

name: Moss Mother
one_line: Enormous winged matriarch encountered in the moss caverns, defending her brood with head-slams.

name: Bell Beast
one_line: Colossal multi-legged transport beast enslaved by ringing copper bells, freed by Hornet to serve as transport.

name: Carmelita
one_line: Fierce ant warrior queen commanding an aggressive colonial legion of specialized soldiers.

name: Seth
one_line: Dedicated eternal guardian who protects an ancient secret, memorializing a fan contributor.

name: Cogwork Dancers
one_line: Pair of synchronized clockwork android dancers powered by coiled brass springs and golden silk.

name: Choir Master
one_line: Theocratic liturgist who orchestrates the harmonic hymns that entrance Pharloom's pilgrims.

name: Grand Mother Silk
one_line: Supreme weaver sovereign who weaves the sacred golden thread to subjugate Pharloom in song.

name: First Weaver
one_line: Mythological matriarchal progenitor who spun the first sentient thread before the rise of the Citadel.

name: Moss Grotto
one_line: Humid moss-covered cavern where Hornet falls after her transport caravan crashes.

name: Bonebottom
one_line: Refuge town constructed of scavenged chitin, bones, and tattered pilgrim cloths.

name: The Marrow
one_line: Hot, dusty industrial furnace complex where enslaved bugs mine mineralized chitin.

name: Deep Docks
one_line: Smoldering subterranean port of molten lava, iron chains, and forge workshops.

name: Greymoor
one_line: Sprawling, misty marshland dotted with ruined towers, crow-like scavengers, and rainwater ponds.

name: Belltower
one_line: Towering stone structure housing colossal bronze bells whose acoustic resonance echoes through the caves.

name: Gilded City
one_line: Affluent merchant district draped in gold leaf, tapestries, and ornate architecture beneath the Citadel.

name: High Citadel
one_line: Vast gleaming theocratic metropolis of white marble, pipe organs, and liturgical chambers.

name: Choral Chambers
one_line: Grand acoustic cathedral where singing choirs enforce the acoustic dominion of Grand Mother Silk.

name: Cogwork Vaults
one_line: Intricate mechanical vaults governed by brass gears, clockwork sentries, and winding mechanisms.

name: Weavers' Cradle
one_line: Sacred ancestral subterranean sanctuary where the Weavers originally spun magical silk.

name: Bile Lake
one_line: Putrid chemical lake where toxic industrial runoff from the Marrow collects.

name: Mount Fay
one_line: Freezing, blizzard-lashed vertical mountain precipice testing Hornet's acrobatic stamina.

name: Peak of Song
one_line: The ultimate summit of Pharloom housing the divine Loom where Grand Mother Silk weaves reality.

name: Sea of Sorrow
one_line: Announced oceanic expansion territory officially revealed by Team Cherry in December 2025.

name: The Void
one_line: Primordial substance of cold emptiness without light or soul, unified through the Void Heart.

name: Soul
one_line: Luminescent spiritual energy animating living bugs, harvested to cast spells or focus healing.

name: Silk
one_line: Tactile, structural biopolymer spun by Weavers used for movement, lethal tools, and healing.

name: The Infection
one_line: Luminescent orange dream parasite spread by the Radiance that strips bugs of will and intellect.

name: Dream Realm
one_line: Ethereal dimension where memories, spirits, gods, and dreams persist beyond physical death.

name: The Weavers
one_line: Ancient arachnid guild possessing magical silkcraft, who fled Pharloom to settle Deepnest.

name: The Moth Tribe
one_line: Ancient tribe born of the Radiance who later turned away to worship the Pale King's beacon.

name: The Mantis Tribe
one_line: Proud territorial warrior society that retained their independence and rejected the King's law.

name: Five Great Knights
one_line: The five legendary champions who served the Pale King: Ogrim, Isma, Ze'mer, Dryya, and Hegemol.

name: Scholars of Soul
one_line: Ambitious researchers who harvested citizen souls in a catastrophic quest for immortality.

name: The Grimm Troupe
one_line: Ritualistic nomadic performers who harvest flames from fallen kingdoms to sustain the Nightmare Heart.

name: The Godseekers
aliases: Attuners of the Land of Storms
one_line: Hive-minded religious seekers pursuing communion with divine gods through the Godtuner.

name: The Citadel Hierarchy
one_line: Theocratic clergy and bell wardens ruling Pharloom through liturgical song and debt servitude.

name: Pilgrims of the Song
one_line: Devout travelers enduring brutal upward pilgrimage to receive the Citadel's musical blessing.

name: The Flea Caravan
one_line: Traveling clan of acrobatic fleas rescued by Hornet and gathered into a lively mobile encampment.

name: The Nailsmith
one_line: Master blacksmith who refines the Knight's Nail to its Pure form, seeking artistic transcendence.

name: Relic Seeker Lemm
one_line: Archaeologist who purchases Hallownest seals, journal relics, and King's Idols while explaining their history.

name: Bardoon
one_line: Immense philosophical caterpillar who scoffs at Wyrms and explains the primordial nature of the Void.

name: The Midwife
one_line: Frightening, ravenous attendant of Herrah who imparts lore regarding Hornet's half-breed birth.

name: Mask Maker
one_line: Enigmatic artisan who carves masks for bugs to grant them defined identities and wills.

name: The Hunter
one_line: Ancient solitary predator who bestows the Hunter's Journal and shares cynical observations on Hallownest.

name: Grubfather
one_line: Weeping father who rewards the Knight with Geo and charms for rescuing his forty-six trapped children.

name: Moss Prophet
one_line: Infected zealot preaching ecstasy in the Radiance's blinding light to a circle of entranced followers.

name: Willoh
one_line: Ravenous bug seen grazing on fungal spores, secretly feeding on discarded bug bodies.

name: Marissa
one_line: Ghost soprano singing sorrowful melodies to an empty pleasure lounge in the capital.

name: Poggy Thor
one_line: Ghost aristocrat lingering in the lift shaft, yearning for delicacies of the royal era.

name: Markoth
one_line: The last warrior of the Moth Tribe, wielding floating spirit shields and spectral nails.

name: Gorb
one_line: Levitating slug mystic who claims to possess an ascended mind and fires spiraling dream needles.

name: Galien
one_line: Noble warrior who trained in Deepnest seeking the King's approval, wielding a spinning scythe scythe.

name: Xero
one_line: Rebellious warrior executed for treason against the Pale King who wields psychic swords in the dream realm.

name: Marmu
one_line: Playful caterpillar spirit who guards the Queen's Gardens, waiting for the Queen's return.

name: No Eyes
one_line: Tragic spirit who plucked out her children's eyes to protect them from dreaming of the Infection.

name: Elder Hu
one_line: Traveling physician who sought to cleanse the Infection but fell victim to madness and was slain.

name: Vengefly King
one_line: Massive predatory insect swooping down from the ceiling to defend its territorial feeding roost.

name: Massive Moss Charger
one_line: Swarm of tiny moss bugs coalesced around a large shell, charging wildly across floral plains.

name: Flukemarm
one_line: Monstrous fleshy parasite mother spawning continuous flukeflies from her corpulent orifices.

name: God Tamer
one_line: Veteran arena gladiator fighting alongside a heavily armored rolling spit-beast in Trial of the Fool.

name: Pure Vessel
aliases: Prime Form of the Hollow Knight
one_line: The Hollow Knight restored to untarnished peak martial prowess before succumbing to infection.

name: Absolute Radiance
one_line: The Radiance unleashed in her unsealed divine majesty at the summit of the pantheons.

name: Winged Nosk
one_line: Nosk taking the physical form of Hornet and sprouting wings to deceive and butcher travelers.

name: Sisters of Battle
one_line: All three Mantis Lords engaging in combat simultaneously at dizzying acrobatic speeds.

name: Mothwing Cloak
one_line: Cloak woven of mothsilk enabling rapid horizontal ground and air dashing.

name: Mantis Claw
one_line: Carved bone claw allowing the bearer to cling to vertical walls and leap upward.

name: Monarch Wings
one_line: Wings of ethereal matter providing an additional leap in mid-air on wings of light.

name: Crystal Heart
one_line: Energy crystal core that propels the bearer forward in sustained horizontal flight.

name: Shade Cloak
one_line: Cloak imbued with the Void that allows dashing through physical enemies and shadow gates unharmed.

name: Isma's Tear
one_line: Fruit formed of a Great Knight's tear that repels burning corrosive acid.

name: King's Brand
one_line: Royal mark burned into the bearer, identifying them as ruler and opening the gates of the Abyss.

name: Dream Nail
one_line: Ancient blade that cuts the veil between waking and dreaming, gathering lost Essence.

name: Void Heart
one_line: Charm uniting the Void under the bearer's sovereign will, silencing their inner Shade.

name: Pinstress
one_line: Craftswoman who fashions straight pins and projectile needle heads from salvaged metals.

name: The Huntress
one_line: Towering predatory insect offering ancient hunting crests in exchange for organ harvests.

name: Ballow
one_line: Energetic flea who guides Hornet toward hidden encampments and lost companions.

name: Drudge
one_line: Exhausted mining worker who recounts stories of the bells and the ceaseless tolling above.

name: Nuu
one_line: Gentle moss child offering environmental wisdom on the flora and damp ecology of lower Pharloom.

name: Flea Master
one_line: Ringmaster who coordinates the traveling circus caravan and rewards Hornet for each rescued flea.

name: Bell Cultist
one_line: Robed devotee ringing resonant bronze bells to direct and disorient migrating pilgrims.

name: Sister of the Loom
one_line: High priestess preserving ancient silk rites who tests Hornet's heritage in woven duel.

name: The Chorus
one_line: Colossal choir of masked liturgical bugs singing synchronized waves of sonic devastation.

name: Puppet-Pilgrims
one_line: Horde of entranced pilgrims suspended by golden threads, manipulated as a unified battle unit.

name: Black Thread Marionettes
one_line: Dark, thread-operated mechanical puppets guarding the forbidden loom archives.

name: Flint Beetle
one_line: Heavily shelled beetle assisting the Forge-Daughter with metallurgical smelting.

name: Skull Prowler
one_line: Savage predator wearing a hollow beast skull who ambushes unwary travelers.

name: Coral Hunter
one_line: Aquatic forager gathering calcified corals and acidic secretions from deep pools.

name: Hunter Crest
one_line: Crest favoring raw needle speed, rapid striking combos, and offensive combat tools.

name: Reaper Crest
one_line: Crest emphasizing wide sweeping strikes, extended silk harvesting, and heavy resource recovery.

name: Wanderer Crest
one_line: Crest tuned for acrobatic velocity, ledge-mantling speed, and mid-air recovery.

name: Weaver Crest
one_line: Ancestral crest empowering silk abilities, spell weaving, and rapid spool regeneration.

name: Architect Crest
one_line: Crest expanding tool slots, enhancing deployable mechanical traps, and reinforcing defensive gear.

name: Straight Pin
one_line: Sharp metal projectile hurled straight ahead to pierce distant enemies.

name: Tri-Pin
one_line: Cluster of three diverging pins thrown in a fan to clear swarms.

name: Pimpillo Bomb
one_line: Combustible spherical explosive that detonates on impact in a fiery blast.

name: Sting Shard
one_line: Barbed caltrop dropped on the ground that impales passing enemies.

name: Curve Sickle
one_line: Curved throwing blade that returns to Hornet's hand after cutting through ranks of foes.

name: Rosary Cannon
one_line: Handheld brass cannon firing high-velocity streams of metallic Rosary beads.

name: Silk Spear
one_line: High-speed piercing thrust of concentrated silk piercing enemy defenses.

name: Thread Storm
one_line: Lethal vortex of slashing razor threads enveloping Hornet in a defensive perimeter.

name: Rosary Beads
one_line: Perforated prayer beads strung on thread, functioning as both currency and ammunition.

name: Shell Shards
one_line: Chitinous fragments harvested from enemies, utilized to craft and repair tools at benches.

name: Unn
one_line: Ancient slug goddess who dreamed Greenpath and its mosskin inhabitants into existence.

name: Queen Vespa
one_line: Deceased queen bee whose spectral form reflects on the limits of expanding beyond one's nature.

name: Snail Shaman
one_line: Enigmatic shaman who grants the Knight spells like Vengeful Spirit and Desolate Dive.

name: Grey Prince Zote
one_line: Monstrously exaggerated dream apparition of Zote born of Bretta's passionate romantic fantasy.

name: White Defender
one_line: Dream manifestation of Ogrim in shining royal armor fighting alongside the Five Great Knights.

name: Traitor's Child
one_line: Daughter of the Traitor Lord and beloved partner of Ze'mer, buried in a solitary floral grave.

name: Pale Lurker
one_line: Deranged former arena champion obsessed with Simple Keys, scuttling across the junk pipes.

name: Revek
one_line: Fierce spectral sentry who defends resting ghost bugs from being harvested by the Dream Nail.

name: Little Fool
one_line: Chained suspended bug who collects entry fees and opens trials for arena combatants.

name: Millibelle the Banker
one_line: Deceitful banker who steals deposited Geo and flees to the Pleasure House in the City of Tears.

name: Wayward Compass
one_line: Charm pinpointing the Knight's exact position on the map.

name: Mark of Pride
one_line: Trophy gifted by the Mantis Lords that greatly extends the reach of the Nail.

name: Quick Slash
one_line: Charm allowing the bearer to swing their weapon at blinding speed.

name: Shaman Stone
one_line: Ancient carved stone that vastly amplifies the power and size of Soul spells.

name: Void Heart Charm
one_line: Dark stone that unifies the Void under the bearer's will.

name: Bell-Striker
one_line: Enforcer striking bronze chimes to regulate pilgrim movement through the vertical shafts.

name: Watcher of the Spire
one_line: Gilded aerial sentry observing the lower districts for signs of heresy or rebellion.

name: Weaver Elder
one_line: Ancient matriarch who preserves the secret history of the Weavers' exile from Pharloom.

name: Gilded Merchant
one_line: Wealthy trader exchanging rare needle components and tools for heavy strings of Rosaries.

name: Flea Cook
one_line: Boisterous flea preparing nourishing broths that temporarily boost Hornet's silk efficiency.

name: The Singer
one_line: Soloist whose ethereal vocal hymns harmonize with the mechanical pipe organs of Pharloom.

name: Bone Carver
one_line: Craftsman who chisels ornate scrimshaw amulets from fossilized chitinous plates.

name: Pilgrim Hermit
one_line: Exiled pilgrim who turned away from the Citadel after witnessing the extraction of weary travelers.

name: Choral Acolyte
one_line: Young initiate learning the sacred choral scales required to enter the High Citadel.

name: Rust Sentry
one_line: Damaged clockwork sentry that retains fragments of industrial history before the kingdom's decay.

name: Scribe of Pharloom
one_line: Historian recording royal liturgies and divine decrees issued from the Peak of Song.

name: Gate Warden
one_line: Stern official checking pilgrim tokens and Rosary offerings before permitting upward transit.

name: Thread Spinner
one_line: Artisan demonstrating advanced spool management techniques and multi-strand needle binding.

name: Spindle Monk
one_line: Monastic bug who meditates on the continuous cycle of unwinding and rewinding thread.

name: Loom Guard
one_line: Elite warrior equipped with woven needle shields guarding the approach to Grand Mother Silk.

name: Coral Golem
one_line: Massive entity formed of living calcified reef and toxic secretions.

name: Lava Crawler
one_line: Armored magma salamander emerging from bubbling molten lakes to scorch intruders.

name: Bronze Knight
one_line: Heavily armored knight wielding a resonant bronze bell-mace that unleashes shockwaves.

name: Gilded Sentry
one_line: Acrobatic palace guard wielding paired golden rapiers adorned with liturgical ribbons.

name: Mechanical Sentinel
one_line: Colossal multi-limbed clockwork contraption firing razor brass gears across the arena.

name: Threaded Phantom
one_line: Spectral weaver spirit that phases through attacks, striking with illusory thread copies.

name: Weaver Matriarch
one_line: Ancient matriarch challenging Hornet to prove her worthiness to inherit the crown of thread.

name: The Conductor
one_line: Masked conductor directing acoustic shockwaves and sonic needles through musical gestures.

name: Sentry of Song
one_line: Paladin empowered by liturgical choral music, regenerating armor through sustained melody.

name: Iron Warden
one_line: Brutal supervisor wielding molten iron tongs and heavy slag chains.

name: Spool Binder
one_line: Acrobatic boss who entangles arena platforms in razor wire, restricting player movement.

name: Bone Crusher
one_line: Feral armored beast that tunnels through ground, causing cavern ceilings to collapse.

name: Cinder Beast
one_line: Predator radiating intense heat that ignites silk spools and leaves burning trails.

name: Mirage Weaver
one_line: Weaver mystic using reflective silk to create deceptive mirror duplicates.

name: Apex Guardian
one_line: Final biological and clockwork hybrid guardian defending Grand Mother Silk's chamber.

name: The Underworks
one_line: Industrial drainage tunnels and pipe labyrinths running beneath the High Citadel.

name: Sunken Spire
one_line: Submerged ancient tower containing flooded chambers and aquatic insect life.

name: Molten Foundry
one_line: Vast industrial foundry casting bronze bells and iron gear components.

name: Pilgrim Road
one_line: Winding stone staircases and processional roads ascending toward the Citadel gates.

name: The Caldera
one_line: Seething volcanic cavern where magma currents power Pharloom's industrial engines.

name: Chimes Peak
one_line: Wind-whipped precipice where hundreds of chime bells ring in howling alpine gales.

name: Silk Bomb
one_line: Explosive canister wrapped in sticky silk that traps foes before detonating.

name: Sprint Thrust
one_line: Devastating forward lunging thrust executed out of a high-speed sprint.

name: Needle Flurry
one_line: Blinding succession of rapid stabs overwhelming enemy guard.

name: Flea Whistle
one_line: Carved bone whistle that summons traveling fleas to retrieve distant items and fallen Rosaries.

name: Rosary Magnet
one_line: Magnetic metal coil that draws loose Rosary beads and shell shards toward Hornet.
